gloss: extremely; excessively; to an extreme degree

definitions.gloss: extremely; excessively; to an extreme degree
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is at a level far beyond what is normal, reasonable, or expected. Often carries a negative nuance, suggesting that the degree is unbalanced or unhealthy, though it can also be used neutrally to emphasize extreme values or behavior.

examples.japanese: {極端|きょくたん}に⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{極端|きょくたん}に{恥|は}ずかし⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧だ。
{極端|きょくたん}に⟦ダイエットする→ダイエットする：11008_daiettosuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧。
examples.english: If you diet to an extreme, you will ruin your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{極端|きょくたん}に⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: Lately, it feels like prices have been rising to an extreme degree.

notes:
The adverbial form of the na-adjective ⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧ (extreme), formed by adding ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. Describes an action, state, or change that goes well beyond normal limits.

USAGE:
- Often implies imbalance or undesirability — something has swung too far in one direction.
- Commonly modifies verbs describing change (⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧, ⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧, ⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧) and adjectives describing quantity or quality (⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧, ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧, ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧, ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧).
- Can be softened with ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧ to ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{極端|きょくたん}に ("a bit extremely"), though ⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧すぎる (too extreme) is more natural for criticism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {極端|きょくたん}に⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: extremely few
- {極端|きょくたん}に⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to go to extremes
- {極端|きょくたん}に⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change drastically
- {極端|きょくたん}に⟦{嫌|きら}う→嫌う：02048_kirau⟧: to hate intensely
- {極端|きょくたん}な⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧: an extreme example

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: extremely — neutral, broadly applicable, no implication of imbalance
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very — everyday speech, weaker than {極端|きょくたん}に
- ものすごく: tremendously — colloquial, emphasizes large degree without the "off-balance" nuance
- ⟦やたら→やたら：07513_yatara⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: excessively / indiscriminately — similar negative nuance but suggests lack of reason or restraint
